description: Deterministic golden-seed dataset for ThermoGuard AI / LandslideGuard demos. These fixtures are hand-picked to be edge-case-proof and require no external API calls -- the demo must run identically every time regardless of network conditions.

scenarios.description: Routine, well-understood gas flare operating within its expected historical range. Should never escalate past LOW severity.

evidence: Inside Industrial Facility boundary (Riverside Gas Flare Station)
Thermal intensity within 10% of facility baseline

scenarios.description: Abnormal industrial thermal spike, more than double the facility's historical baseline, inside a chemical plant boundary. This is the 'killer demo' escalation event.

evidence: Inside Industrial Facility boundary (Demo Chemical Plant)
Unexpected spatial pattern relative to known flare stacks

scenarios.description: Low-intensity thermal signal over a known agricultural belt during typical crop-burning season. Correctly de-prioritized rather than treated as an industrial event.

evidence: Inside Agricultural Land region boundary (Kurnool Agricultural Belt)
Low FRP consistent with seasonal crop burning
No nearby industrial facility within 25 km
